aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, an overview helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you don’t have to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo in your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen for customers showing order numbers and when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date links straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you have no signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long that takes: the maximum number of orders per time slot. Once a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty stamp cards — collecting and redeeming stamps happens automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise your average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Just like the WhatsApp auto-replies, but for questions via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login with the right access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If your connection drops, online ordering pauses so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you just keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Have customers pay by card up front when they order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a latest order time for dishes that need preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers a text automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically put your dates, locations and times on them, for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Set any dish to sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock level: it counts down as orders come in and then sets the dish to sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or cable printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot as their collection time, so the rush is spread across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.
